$comment: TU.4 / T3.9: end states of the moving scenes, rendered by Cycles (render.py --end-state <id>, written to bench/references/<id>/<camera>/) and set up the same way by the m4-textured-accuracy page (job.endState). `moves` turn an object about a pivot (manifest space, as the viewer's motion drivers: pivot x turn x pivot^-1 x rest); `boxes` stand a Lambert box against the scene's floor and the wall at its lowest z, as the ddgi-move-cabinet page does (x is the centre; floorGap and wallGap in metres; color is the sRGB hex three reads). Cameras are bookmarks of the end state that the manifest doesn't have.

door-shut.title: closed-door as authored: the door panel shut in the doorway (door-swing's end state)

door-open.title: the door swung 90 degrees open into room A (door-swing's keyframe t=0)

cabinet-before.title: ddgi-move-cabinet before the move: a 0.9 x 0.85 x 0.45 m brown box against the north wall

cabinet-moved.title: ddgi-move-cabinet after the move: the cabinet slid 1 m along the wall (+x)
